project.title: Aerobic bacterial enrichment cultures that degraded 2,2-bis[4-hydroxyphenyl]propane(BPA) and its substitute-BPAF . Raw sequence reads
project.description: The objective of this study is to identify functional bacteria that participate in the degradation of 2,2-bis[4-hydroxyphenyl]propane phosphate and its substitute-BPAF .
project.center_name: Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences
